name: Squared Square
desc: Squaring the strip forever — unequal squares drop into the lowest notch of a rising skyline and lock together with no gap and no overlap, each still glowing with the heat of being laid and each stamped with its own order, the finished dissection scrolling away beneath.

energy.doc: ink contrast + line weight + scroll rate + chiaroscuro depth

scale.doc: square size vs frame — 2.2 lays a handful of colossal squares, 0.5 a fine dissection

density.doc: size spread — 0 is greedy max-fit (big slabs), 1 shatters the strip into many small orders

numerals.doc: opacity of the order numeral stamped in each square

hatch.doc: engraved hatching ruled across each face

x.doc: strip x offset as canvas fraction

y.doc: strip y offset as canvas fraction

style.doc: aesthetic: sepia copperplate dissection figure / cyan schematic on prussian / two-ink risograph / chalk on slate / luminous additive cells on black (non-representational)

seed.doc: the dissection itself — reseeds every square placement
